page_topic_one_liner: Indie hackers bootstrapping playbook — MVP principles, Build in Public tactics, and revenue milestones from solo founder success stories
differentiator_vs_generic: This is solo founder bootstrapping strategy analysis, NOT generic startup motivation or VC pitch deck imagery. Hero must be a Build in Public timeline with MRR milestone markers, MVP launch node, and public-building social feed strip.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Build in Public timeline — horizontal journey line from MVP launch dot through public updates to revenue milestone markers ($1K, $10K, $100K blur labels)
Solo founder workstation motif — laptop with blurred dashboard + small audience growth curve beside timeline
Secondary: three-strategy card strip — ship fast / talk publicly / iterate on feedback as annotated playbook blocks
anti_patterns: Generic handshake or team meeting stock photo
SERP or SEO dashboard as hero
